frequency_question: How often do sovereigns with executive control renew bilateral resource treaties prior to expiration?
membership_rule: Includes signed bilateral water or shared-resource treaties between sovereign states that reached their expiration or renewal milestone within the modern era. Excludes multilateral treaties, domestic resource pacts, or treaties unilaterally abrogated before expiration.

cases.name: US-Canada Columbia River Treaty Implementation Protocol
India-Pakistan Indus Waters Treaty continuous implementation
Senegal River Basin Development Authority Convention renewals
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase agreements
Mekong River Commission Agreement renewal framework

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major international resource treaty renewals/extensions; exhaustive of prominent comparable sovereign bilateral water resource accords.
known_gaps: Minor technical amendments to obscure local basin pacts omitted due to lack of distinct executive principal involvement.
validity_reason: State practice regarding vital shared water resources remains stable across multi-year geopolitical cycles unless fundamental sovereignty shifts occur.
